title: Introduce pre-decision prefilter to reduce tracing hotpath cost
creator: Maya Patel
description: Background: several high-qps services report tracer CPU allocations and increased P50 CPU during request hotpath. Current tail-based and reservoir samplers decide downstream after span construction and metadata encoding, which amplifies cost for spans that would be dropped. Goal: add a lightweight pre-decision prefilter at the ingress/hook level that cheaply classifies ~60-95% of low-value spans before heavy allocation work. The prefilter must be KV-cache-aware (avoid biasing samples when prefix hits are common), support a probabilistic correction factor, and emit observability metrics to track false-positive/negative rates. Scope: prototype in agent SDK and ingress middleware, add metrics, benchmark, roll out via canary on non-critical services, update dashboards and alerting. Non-goals: replacing tail-based sampling or changing sampling policies; this is complementary to existing downstream samplers.
acceptance_criteria: Prefilter implemented in agent SDK and ingress middleware with <50ns median CPU overhead per request when prefilter path taken
End-to-end CPU allocations for instrumented service reduced by >=25% at 95th percentile of sampled requests in canary
No measurable increase in tracing-tail loss: effective tail sampling recall >= 98% for priority spans (error/root/cold-start) during benchmarks
Metrics emitted: prefilter.decisions{kept,dropped}, prefilter.fallbacks, prefilter.latency_histogram, prefilter.bias_correction_factor
Runbook and rollout plan documented with rollback thresholds and feature flag gates
comments: 2026-02-18 - Maya Patel: Created ticket after incident-2026-02-16 where homepage-service tracer increased CPU by ~18%. Attached initial allocation flamegraph.
2026-02-23 - Ethan Zhao: Spike prototype (go) implemented: uses two-byte fingerprint + LRU salt per worker to cheaply hash route+user bucket. Initial microbench: ~42ns median, 120ns 99th.

2026-03-02 - Benchmarks: canary-sidecar run against replay traffic from 2026-02-16 incident; end-to-end P95 CPU reduced 28% on test pods. Observed a small bias against cache-hit prefixes (7% lower keep-rate for cached flows).

2026-03-05 - Design review notes: agreed to add KV-cache-aware correction: multiply keep-probability by (1 + sqrt(cache_hit_rate)*alpha) where alpha is sampled from config. Action: add telemetry to estimate cache_hit_rate per route and tune alpha.
2026-03-09 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/agent-sdk/pull/823 - includes prefilter implementation + unit tests + feature flag. Pending security review for telemetry labels.
2026-03-11 - PM feedback (Lena O'Connor): Ensure dashboards show correlation between prefilter drop-rate and downstream evals (sample quality). Add link to quality-regressions playbook.

2026-03-14 - QA: integration test run succeeded; observed a pathological route where prefilter dropped 12% of authenticator-failed spans. Added route-level override config and default conservative policy for auth paths. Preparing canary rollout next week.
